affected_subject.reason: Identifies disputeToken, disputeTree(), resolveDispute(), and disputer state as affected components.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: FoT token configured as disputeToken and user calls disputeTree(), then resolveDispute() is invoked.

direct_effect.reason: resolveDispute() always reverts with transfer amount exceeds balance, disputer stays non-zero, both resolution branches fail.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conservation/state-transition relation: recorded disputeAmount exceeds actual received balance, and resolveDispute is the only path clearing disputer, so expected resolution vs actual permanent revert is derivable.

summary: Report explains affected functions/state, FoT-token trigger, concrete revert and permanent disputer lock, and the balance-vs-recorded-amount conservation basis, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
